Row.Text: Xu Jiayin Leads China v1.2.1 — Stability Hotfix
许家印领导中华帝国 v1.2.1——稳定性热修复
Version 1.2.1 stabilizes the Sales Network reward and keeps Construction Site Security active through the world's Classical Era.
v1.2.1“稳定性热修复”：稳定销售网络奖励，并让工地保安持续至世界古典时代结束。

Adds Xu Jiayin as an alternate leader for China in Civilization VI: Gathering Storm. Version 1.2.1 removes the unstable scripted Trader reward, replaces it with speed-scaled Gold, and corrects the world-era timing of Construction Site Security.
为《文明VI：风云变幻》的中华帝国添加替代领袖许家印。v1.2.1移除不稳定的脚本商人奖励，改为随游戏速度缩放的金币，并修正工地保安的世界时代判定。
Xu Jiayin
许家印

Xu Jiayin, you rose from an unassuming beginning into the light of towering skylines, writing speed, scale, and promises into the construction plans of an empire. Lead China forward at full speed—but remember that every wonder must eventually be accounted for.
许家印，你从不起眼的起点走进摩天楼的灯光里，把速度、规模和承诺写进帝国的施工蓝图。带领中华文明高歌猛进吧——只是别忘了，每一座奇迹，最终都要结算。

Xu Jiayin believes that a problem large enough can begin to resemble a vision, and that a plan moving fast enough can leave the bill for the next turn. Under his leadership, cities expand rapidly in the early game, struggle to maintain momentum in the middle game, and later rely on Guaranteed Delivery Programs, Hengchi Vehicles, and a sufficiently grand gateway to preserve appearances. How history will settle the account remains uncertain—the financial report is still loading.
许家印相信，问题只要足够大，就会显得像愿景；计划只要足够快，就能把账单留给下一回合。在他的领导下，城市前期野蛮生长，中期忙于周转，后期则依靠保交楼工程、恒驰汽车与一座足够宏伟的大门维持体面。历史最终会如何结算尚未可知——财务报表仍在加载。
Advance at full speed. Leave the rest for the next turn.
先高歌猛进，剩下的事情留到下一回合。
Advance at Full Speed
高歌猛进

【Glorious Expansion | Ancient and Classical】[NEWLINE]Cities expand rapidly and gain additional yields, while Settlers, buildings, the first specialty district in each city, and land-unit training are completed faster. Land combat units gain +8 Combat Strength against Barbarians. Low-population new cities can use Early Development Projects for financing and temporary Amenities. Capturing and retaining a city founded by another civilization triggers Asset Takeover. The first Commercial Hub or Harbor completed permanently grants +1 Trade Route Capacity and speed-scaled Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]【High-Leverage Expansion | Medieval and Renaissance】[NEWLINE]Specialty districts and buildings are constructed faster, and Great Merchant and Great Engineer points increase. Cities with too many districts incur additional debt and Amenity pressure.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]【Debt Restructuring | Industrial Era and later】[NEWLINE]National Gold output falls, while district-dense cities suffer heavier debt, Amenity, and yield penalties. A Guaranteed Delivery Program can ease part of the Production pressure.

【风光无限｜远古、古典】[NEWLINE]城市快速扩张并获得额外产出；开拓者、建筑、首个专业区域和陆军训练速度提高。陆地战斗单位对蛮族+8战斗力。低人口新城可通过前期开发项目获得融资和临时宜居度。首次占领并保留其他文明建立的城市时触发资产接管。首次建成商业中心或港口时，永久增加1点贸易路线容量并获得一笔随游戏速度缩放的金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]【高杠杆扩张｜中古、文艺复兴】[NEWLINE]专业区域与建筑建造加快，大商人与大工程师点数提高；城市区域过多时产生额外债务和宜居度压力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]【债务重组｜工业时代以后】[NEWLINE]全国金币产出下降，区域密集城市承担更高债务、宜居度和产出惩罚；保交楼工程可缓解部分生产压力。

销售网络

全国销售网络已经建立：贸易路线容量+1，并获得{1_Amount}金币。
Guaranteed Delivery Program
保交楼工程

A City Center building unique to Xu Jiayin, unlocked at Urbanization. Provides 2 Housing, 1 Amenity, and 3 Gold per turn. From the Industrial Era onward, in a city with at least 5 specialty districts, it offsets the 15% Production penalty from Debt Restructuring. Land combat units purchased in this city cost 20% less.
城市化市政解锁的许家印专属城市中心建筑。提供2点住房、1点宜居度和每回合3金币。工业时代以后，若本城拥有至少5个专业区域，则抵消债务重组的15%生产力处罚；本城购买陆地战斗单位的费用降低20%。

Rapid urban expansion can leave major construction commitments requiring additional capital, production, and administration. In addition to 2 Housing, 1 Amenity, and 3 Gold, the Guaranteed Delivery Program restores the 15% Production lost by a five-district city during Debt Restructuring and reduces the purchase cost of land combat units in this city by 20%. It does not restore Gold or Science, remove fixed debt, or apply the Production recovery to less-developed cities.
高速城市扩张留下了大量需要继续投入资源完成和维护的建设项目。除2点住房、1点宜居度和每回合3金币外，保交楼工程会在债务重组期间为五区城市恢复被扣除的15%生产力，并使本城购买陆地战斗单位的费用降低20%。它不会恢复金币或科技、免除固定债务，也不会让低开发城市无条件获得生产力。

Hengchi Vehicle
恒驰汽车

A Modern Armor replacement unique to Xu Jiayin. Costs 580 Production, has 90 Combat Strength and 5 Movement, and gains +10 Combat Strength in its owner's territory. It retains Modern Armor's maintenance, Oil requirement, unit class, upgrade path, model, animation, and audio.
许家印专属的现代装甲单位，替代现代坦克。生产成本580，基础战斗力90，移动力5；在己方领土内获得10点战斗力。保留现代坦克的维护费、石油需求、单位类别、升级路线、模型、动画与音效。
Domestic Supply Chain
本土产业链
+10 Combat Strength while fighting in this unit owner's territory.
在己方领土内战斗时获得10点战斗力。
Domestic Supply Chain: +{1_Amount} [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength while fighting in this unit owner's territory.
本土产业链：在己方领土内作战时+{1_Amount} [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

The Hengchi Vehicle represents a modern manufacturing project supported by large-scale capital and industrial investment. In gameplay it costs 580 Production, has 90 Combat Strength and 5 Movement, and reaches 100 Combat Strength in friendly territory through its +10 Domestic Supply Chain bonus. It retains Modern Armor's maintenance, Oil requirement, class, upgrades, model, animation, and audio.
恒驰汽车代表在大规模资本和产业投入下形成的现代制造项目。在游戏中，它需要580生产力，具有90战斗力与5移动力，并通过“本土产业链”在己方领土达到100战斗力。其维护费、石油需求、单位类别、升级路线、模型、动画与音效均沿用现代坦克。

Evergrande Yuhu Gate
恒大御湖天下大门

A National Wonder unique to Xu Jiayin, unlocked at Urbanization and limited to one per player. Upon completion, grants Gold scaled by game speed and gives all cities +15% Production toward units, specialty districts, and non-Wonder buildings for a limited duration. Its city permanently gains 4 Housing, 2 Amenities, and 8 Gold per turn. All cities receive +25% Production toward the Guaranteed Delivery Program, increased to a final +50% in this city.
许家印专属国家奇观，城市化市政解锁，每名玩家最多建造一座。建成时获得随游戏速度缩放的金币，并使所有城市在一段时间内建造单位、专业区域和非奇观建筑时获得15%生产力。所在城市永久获得4点住房、2点宜居度和每回合8金币。所有城市建造保交楼工程时生产力提高25%，本城最终提高50%。

Large ceremonial gateways and showcase developments can be used to shape a project's image, attract attention, and support capital recovery. In gameplay, the Evergrande Yuhu Gate represents a concentrated promotional and financial recovery effort, providing a temporary production window while sustaining the core city's housing, amenities, and finances.
大型城市入口和展示性建筑常被用于塑造项目形象、吸引关注并推动资金回笼。在游戏中，恒大御湖天下大门代表一次集中宣传和资本回收，为债务压力下的帝国提供短暂的生产恢复窗口，同时维持核心城市的住房、宜居度和财政。

Grand Opening
盛大开盘
All cities receive +15% Production toward units, specialty districts, and non-Wonder buildings. This bonus does not apply to Wonders, the Evergrande Yuhu Gate, or city projects.
所有城市建造单位、专业区域和非奇观建筑时获得15%生产力。该加成不适用于奇观、恒大御湖天下大门或城市项目。
I am Xu Jiayin. Let us see what we can build together.
我是许家印。让我们看看能共同创造些什么。
Welcome. Shall we continue our discussion at my capital?
欢迎。我们是否前往我的首都继续商谈？
Then let us meet here and speak plainly.
那么就在这里见面，开诚布公地谈一谈吧。
Evergrande Yuhu World Gateway
恒大御湖天下大门
The grand vision has finally been fulfilled—at least, the gate has been delivered.
宏伟蓝图终于兑现——至少，大门已经交付。
